name: fs-tooldirs-read
note: `$tooldirs` grants read on the package-manager / toolchain cache dirs so a build can resolve deps from the store, while an ungranted project path stays denied. The nub store/cache anchors track the NUB embedder profile (data_namespace=nub, cache_namespace=nub/pm); XDG_CACHE_HOME is pointed at the fixture home by the harness, so $cache resolves under it. macOS/Linux only — the Windows AppContainer allowlist cannot carve the compiler's .env* read-deny out of the grant (covered by the other fs fixtures' fail-closed path).
